calibration_config.system: You are a helpful assistant. Answer clearly and concisely.
calibration_config.selection_rule: Prefer largest target per layer with both signs within tolerance and mean KL below cap; choose median-ranked candidate by paired mean KL, tie by channel index. Skip a layer if neither target has an eligible candidate.
calibration_config.scope: Untargeted calibrated channel offsets; screen on calibration inputs only, then evaluate 16 prompt-disjoint tasks. No persona or benchmark-improvement target.

resume.reason: Parent atomic replacement failed with Windows PermissionError; prior complete JSON preserved.
resume.limitation: Interrupted segment has no final parameter-version check. Resumed segment is checked separately.

limits: One pinned model, one greedy trajectory per prompt/condition; exploratory, no confidence intervals.
Exact checks combine answer and strict format; other domains have no automatic correctness grade.
Relative L2 is measured at the intervened block post_ffn_norm, not the whole residual stream.
Calibration statistics include neutral system tokens; decode-position strengths are not measured.
Screen selection uses calibration KL and strength only; evaluation text does not select units.
